PresenterIntent: Project identity, label, type, and capability hints into a compact selectable presentation model.
RecognizerIntent: Treat selecting, copying, or opening the presentation as typed action requests over the underlying semantic subject.
LoweringRationale: If an object can be compactly referenced and inspected, the PBUI layer needs a first-class presentation object that can be selected, copied, or used as the subject of later commands. This rule is the generic bridge from Interaction IR object references into CLIM-style presentation refs.
